messages:
Maria (Marketing): Hey team — final draft of the product post is up for review: https://drive.redwood/drafts/post-final-v3.md :eyes:
Maria (Marketing): Need final copy + legal ok + UTM/webinar routing by EOD so we can queue for Wed publish. TL;DR at top, hero options attached.
Ben (Design): looking now. quick note — hero A reads a bit busy on small screens, can we try tighter crop? :thinking_face:
Ben (Design): I'll upload a trimmed version in an hour.
Priya (Product): skimmed. tech accuracy check: we should say "dedicated capacity" rather than "reserved GPUs" in the opener. small ask.
Owen (SEO): Title suggestion: "How Redwood Inference Cuts LLM Latency and Cost for Product Teams" — keeps keywords. meta desc idea: "Reduce token cost and latency with Redwood's unified inference runtime — benchmarks and migration tips." Thoughts?
Linh (Growth): UTMs — we should route demo/webinar signups to the product-marketing funnel. Suggested UTM template for the main CTA: 
```
utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=cta_hero
```
Linh (Growth): Also need HubSpot form id and mapping for "interest=dedicated" so inbound leads auto-tag.
Raj (Legal): Quick flag on the privacy paragraph: "we do not access customer data" is too strong. Suggest: "Redwood does not access customer request payloads except as required to provide the service or comply with law; customers may opt into sharing logs for troubleshooting."
Maria (Marketing): good catch Raj — will edit to your wording.
Priya (Product): also confirm model naming — doc currently says "Redwood-Optim" which is internal. pls change to "Redwood-Verified Optimized Models" or similar.
Owen (SEO): slug suggestion: /blog/dedicated-inference-playbook — shorter and search-friendly. Internal redirect ok?
Maria (Marketing): agreed on slug. Ben thanks for hero crop. Linh please send HubSpot form id. Raj — once you sign off I'll push the privacy tweak.
Linh (Growth): form id is 8a7f2b3c. Mapping: email -> email, company -> company, interest -> checkbox (value: dedicated). I'll paste webhook mapping after this.
Ben (Design): uploaded hero_B_crop.jpg to the doc folder and left alt text: "engine room servers with abstracted inference graph". :thumbsup:
Priya (Product): minor copy edit in section 3: replace "KV cache" with "KV cache (prefix caching)" for clarity.
Maria (Marketing): made those edits and updated draft: https://drive.redwood/drafts/post-final-v4.md
Owen (SEO): quick on-page checklist from me: H1, meta, OG image, canonical, twitter card. I'll drop a checklist in the doc.
Raj (Legal): reviewed updated privacy line. Acceptable. one more small ask: remove the "SLA-backed" phrase from a customer quote unless we have direct permission.
Maria (Marketing): ok — removed SLA mention from quote.
Linh (Growth): HubSpot webhook mapping: 
```
{
  "formId": "8a7f2b3c",
  "fields": {
    "email": "email",
    "company": "company",
    "interest": "dedicated"
  },
  "tag": "campaign:dedicated_launch"
}
```
Linh (Growth): we'll set inbound routing to sales_aes for MQLs scoring >= 50.
Maria (Marketing): planning publish canary: Wed 10am PST -> full roll at 1pm if no issues. can someone from eng stand by for quick patch in first hour?
Priya (Product): I'll be on standby 9:30-11:30.
Ben (Design): I'll be available for quick asset fixes 9-12.
deploy-bot: Scheduled publish job created for 2026-03-25T10:00:00-07:00 (job id: publish-179004).
Maria (Marketing): thanks all. final check — anyone object to go-live with current draft? :raised_hands:
Owen (SEO): :+1:
Priya (Product): :thumbsup:
Ben (Design): :thumbsup:
Raj (Legal): :white_check_mark:
Linh (Growth): MQL routing in place. :rocket:
Maria (Marketing): Great — closing thread. I'll ping QA channel if anything pops during roll.
